name: ELECTRICI.D.FRANCE E0-,50
summary: Electricité de France (EDF) is a French multinational electric utility company, primarily involved in electricity generation, transmission, distribution, and supply. EDF is one of the largest electricity producers in the world, operating a diverse portfolio of power plants, including nuclear, hydro, and renewable energy sources, with its headquarters in Paris, France. The company serves residential, commercial, and industrial customers across Europe and internationally.
